Anika (CS): Heads up 10 - Verdant Health procurement wants a concise SLA summary for their legal packet. They asked for the MUP definition, p50/p95 latency targets, credit calc + cap, and a short onboarding timeline. Renewal cadence: 6 weeks. Can @Tobias and @Kai confirm numbers?
Tobias (SRE): Hosted: MUP = 99.9% monthly uptime. p50 = 110ms, p95 = 350ms typical for standard API routes. Dedicated: 99.95% MUP; p95 may reach ~600ms during initial model warm-up.
Kai (Solutions): recommend this language: "Latency SLOs measured on steady-state traffic; transient deviations during initial rollout, model swaps, or cold cache warming are excluded from steady-state calculations but are called out in the onboarding guidance."
Anika (CS): credits 10 - do we want to show an example? Keep it minimal for procurement.
Tobias (SRE): use this example calc: ```credit = round(min(0.3, max(0, (SLO_target - observed_MUP) / SLO_target)) * committed_monthly_fee, 2)``` cap = 30% monthly. Example: $15,000/mo, target 99.9%, observed 99.7% -> shortfall 0.2% -> credit ≈ $30.
Kai (Solutions): I'll build a 1-row table comparing Hosted vs Dedicated with suggested add-ons: reserved capacity, pre-warm window, escalation SLA. Also note Dedicated lead time 2-3 weeks.
Rafael (AE): Verdant uses bursty inference during business hours; recommend reserved concurrency + pre-warm slot for first 2 weeks of ramp. I'll prepare pricing bullets.
Anika (CS): action items: (1) Tobias - paste final PromQL and dashboard link; (2) Kai - draft the one-pager and table; (3) Rafael - pricing bullets and renewal owner. I'll send to procurement by EOD Friday.
LegalBot: Reminder: attach the legal appendix template for SLA to procurement packet.
Tobias (SRE): metric name confirmed: "monthly uptime percentage (MUP)". PromQL sample: `sum_over_time(up{job="inference"}[30d]) / (30*24*3600)`. I'll add dashboard snapshot link once ready.
Kai (Solutions): adding a short onboarding timeline: Day 0: kickoff; Day 1: API keys + smoke tests; Day 3: canary + perf tuning; Day 7: full prod. Optional accelerated 3-4 day path with pre-warm slot.
Anika (CS): great. Drop final text into https://redwood.docs/verdant/sla-summary by Thursday 11:00 PT. Thanks :pray:
